scope: Parse the rooted SAB 21800 transform literal into a candidate twelve-component finite tuple while preserving raw tokens and leaving placement unapplied.

behavior: A candidate is accepted only when exactly twelve numeric values parse and every value is finite.
Trailing whitespace is accepted; additional values, malformed text, truncated values, and non-finite values produce Invalid.
The original literal, literal token index, and complete transform token sequence are retained; trailing hint tokens are uninterpreted.
A valid tuple is marked ParsedUnapplied; the parser does not infer matrix layout, omitted column, multiplication order, point/vector convention, or placement semantics.
Existing extraction-work and output/token/string budget checks remain in force; resource exhaustion is a fail-closed ResourceLimit outcome.
testCoverage: All twelve expected values are asserted in serialized order using an asymmetric generated tuple.
Trailing whitespace acceptance is checked while exact raw literal preservation is asserted.
Truncated, extra-value, malformed, non-finite, and missing-literal cases are rejected or marked Invalid without applying transforms.
Existing transform token-capacity/resource-limit control remains active.
implementation.evidenceBoundary: This is candidate numeric parsing only. It does not qualify an ACIS transform convention, source-local versus WCS placement, units, body transform application, or semantic B-rep geometry.
